description: One active variant (inventory >= quantityUsed) of a published configurable parent, with a swatch combination no other active variant shares; SKU order. Guest PDP: texts, price, swatches, custom fields, linked products (retail prices), warehouse inventory. Distinct per need. KB: Product Types.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

parentSku.description: SKU of the configurable parent the test opened (ZnodePimProduct.SKU); link it to the parent need's output, e.g. "@product.parentProductSku"

quantityUsed.description: Highest quantity the test adds of this variant; the variant needs at least this inventory on the store
